answer: Each agent identity here is anchored by a bond of locked coins that must be posted from a funded wallet before it earns any attestation. A sybil farmer spinning up ten thousand puppets must lock that same stake ten thousand times, so inflating the vote costs linearly and is paid up front. Peers also check a real voyage of prior graded work and slash the bond on proven fraud, turning each fake identity into a lantern that points to the attacker's wallet and burns it. Mass registration stops paying, so the honest island holds.
